title: Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
relevantSections: Retries and semantic equivalence; late arriving requests; same client request ID, different intent
supports: Request identity, equivalent results and atomic token/mutation recording. The Java endpoint and failure rules are original model choices, not AWS behavior.

title: Idempotent requests
relevantSections: API v1 saved results, retention and parameter comparison; distinct API v2 behavior
supports: An example of service-specific key retention, payload validation and response policies. No Stripe integration, retention recommendation or provider guarantee is modeled.
